normal.name: Brandon Scott Partin
normal.text: Here lately, I’ve seen other people downing others for being into video games. There is this idea you can’t game and have a balance in your life with your work and your ability to take care of yourself. I have an absolute passion for games but does it take away from my work? No. I can still work on myself and take care of myself while still decompressing. You can have both. #videogames

normal.name: Mike
normal.text: Am I the only one not obsessing over #GTA6 ? It's a fantastic technical achievement, but there's very little in the game that attracts me to play it (or even watch it). The last time I had a lot of fun with GTA was with the top-down games back in the day. I have just accepted that the entire industry, news/media, streamers, content creators, etc will be pushing out almost only GTA6 content for a couple of weeks. I’m just bored of it. #Games

normal.name: Guy LeCharles Gonzalez
normal.text: First weekend in months with no major house chores, and both my Xbox and (new!) gaming PC are finally hooked up, so I'm planning on a few days of comfort gaming. Tonight I jumped back into Cyber Knights: Flashpoint for the first time on a proper PC, and Space Marine 2 on the rusty Xbox. Both took a bit to get used to again after long breaks, and both sounded great through real speakers. Also looking forward to trying out Jagged Alliance 3 for the first time. #gaming
